altruism: Alter: other. Altruism puts others first.
Altruism: donating a kidney to a stranger.
assail: Ad + salire: leap at. Assailed with questions.
Assail: the crowd attacking the speaker with insults.
assuage: Suavis: sweet. Assuage hunger, assuage guilt.
augment: Augment: add on, as in augmented reality.
banish: Ban: proclaim out. Banish the king.
Banish a thought from your mind.
benign: Bene + genus: well born. A benign tumour is harmless.
buck: Buck: a horse jumping. Buck the trend: go against it.
Buck the system: refuse to comply.
commendable: Commendable: gets a pat on the back.
conducive: Conducere: lead to. A quiet room is conducive to study.
Conducive: sets up the right outcome.
contemptuous: Contemptuous: looking down at the waiter.
cornucopia: Cornu + copia: horn of plenty. A cornucopia of fruit.
credence: Credere: believe. Lend credence to a rumour.
Credence: how much you believe it.
debase: De + bas: lower. Debase the currency.
detrimental: Detritus: worn away. Detrimental to health.
egotist: Ego: I. An egotist talks about himself.
elaborate: E + laborare: work out. Elaborate on your point; an elaborate plan.
empathetic: Em + pathos: feel in. An empathetic nurse.
euphoria: Eu + pherein: carry well. Euphoria after winning.
facetious: Facetiae: jests. A facetious remark at a funeral.
fickle: Fickle: shifting. Fickle weather, fickle friends.
genteel: Gentil: noble. Genteel manners: refined, a bit snobbish.
hamstrung: Hamstring: cut tendon. Hamstrung by red tape.
illicit: In + licere: not allowed. Illicit trade.
impeccable: In + peccare: no sin. Impeccable manners.
inadvertent: In + advertere: not paying attention. An inadvertent error.
irresolute: Not resolute: can’t decide. An irresolute leader.
lucid: Lux: light. Lucid explanation; lucid dream.
perennial: Per + annus: through the years. Perennial plants return each spring.
precedent: Pre + cedere: gone before. Set a precedent.
rankle: Draconculus: little dragon, a festering sore. His comment still rankles.
smattering: Smatter: splash. A smattering of French.
spurn: Spurn: kick away. Spurn an offer.
tawdry: St Audrey’s lace: cheap souvenirs. Tawdry jewellery.
tumult: Tumultus: uproar. Tumult in the square.
unruly: Not ruly: disobeys. An unruly class.
whimsical: Whim: sudden notion. A whimsical cartoon.
